summary: Legacy dropdown visual, hidden from the node picker — superseded by net.noodl.controls.options (Dropdown).
description: The original Options (select) visual, kept only so old projects load. The Dropdown control (net.noodl.controls.options) supersedes it with items/value binding, visual states and accessibility.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.controls.options instead.
runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups gate box-shadow and width/height ports on parameter values; irrelevant for new work — the node is hidden from the picker.
